Vogl, V., Åhman, M. and Nilsson, L.J. (2018). Supplementary information (mmc1) for: Assessment of hydrogen direct reduction for fossil-free steelmaking. Journal of Cleaner Production 203, 736-745. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jclepro.2018.08.279

Supplementary docx (1-s2.0-S0959652618326301-mmc1) of the paper already extracted as vogl_2018_hydrogen-direct-reduction-steelmaking_jclepro (same source-id); verified by content (H-DR model, electrolyser 72%, 431 EUR/tLS base, 0.59 EUR/W, Midrex shaft at 800 degC, BF/BOF comparison from IEAGHG 2013). Locators are SI section and table labels (no page numbers in the docx). Sections: A1 sensitivity (Table a), A2 inputs (Tables b, c, VBA constants), A3 model equations. Most inputs (pellets 100 EUR/t, scrap 180, labour 53.2, alloys, O2 60.8 EUR/t at 60% sold, EAF 184 and shaft 230 EUR/t, electrolyser 0.59 EUR/W and 10 y, 20 y and 5%) are already in the main extraction and are not repeated. New and loaded: the base-case H-DR production cost 431 EUR/tLS at 40 EUR/MWh and 401 at 50% scrap, HEX efficiency 75%, and the BF/BOF comparison route (opex 304, production cost 318 EUR/tLS, 1.870 tCO2/t, brownfield capex 170, relining 48.3 EUR/t). Other-values: sensitivity table, EAF SEC adjustment factors, model plant size. Price year not stated anywhere: 2018_EUR assumed as in the main extraction. Note the SI marks the coking-coal cost as used only in the sensitivity.
